column1: #mapping_set_description: Working FEN namespace mapped onto the draft cvkg SKG-IF extension. DRAFT — the cvkg: IRIs resolve only after the extension is endorsed.

column8: Same controlled vocabulary (pending/validated/disputed/rejected); renamed on the extension namespace.
Same three concepts (QuadraticVoting/PeerReview/automated → community vote/expert review/automated).
FEN uses ARK PIDs (ADR-003); the extension keeps it optional and any-URI so that nodes without a PID service can still participate.
FEN publishes a separate reputation snapshot PID; the extension models only classes and counts. The snapshot stays node-local for now.
SIMULATED in the reference implementation (0xMOCK, no ledger). The extension deliberately allows any hash and adds cvkg:assertionIsSimulated to keep demo data distinguishable.
Non-Interference note: the assertion is a prov:Entity so that PROV-O tooling can traverse it, but validation semantics are NOT expressed with PROV-O alone.
A candidate is a contribution to a research product; the extension attaches the assertion to the product and keeps candidates node-side.
